visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a white top, stands in front of a stone structure under bright daylight. She smiles at the camera while holding a blank sheet of paper. In the background, an elderly man wearing a red long-sleeved shirt and a large tan straw hat sits on a bucket next to several large cactus pads. (2) The elderly man, now the focus, sits on a bucket and holds a clipboard. He uses his fingers to rub a small red insect, known as a cochineal, onto a white paper to create a vibrant red pigment. He wears several rings on his fingers. Nearby, there are various organic materials like leaves and flowers. (3) The camera captures a close-up of the man's weathered hands as he takes green tobacco leaves and rubs them onto the paper, producing a green color. He then picks up a bright orange marigold flower and applies its petals to create yellow highlights. The background shows the weathered stones of an ancient pyramid site. (4) The man uses a knife to slice open a large, flat cactus pad. He applies the clear, viscous juice onto the painted areas of the paper. He then sprinkles a fine white powder over the wet juice. The paper is held steady on a clipboard. (5) As the white powder touches the cactus juice, the color instantly transforms into a deep, vivid blue. The man continues to work on the sunflower painting. Finally, the woman reappears, holding the finished colorful sunflower painting against the backdrop of the pyramid, smiling broadly at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 用仙人掌畫畫的爺爺. [Subtitle]: 我在墨西哥收到超棒的紀念品！. (2) [Subtitle]: 是這個爺爺畫給我的！. (3) [Subtitle]: 畫家的第一步. [Variety]: look ->. [Slogan]: 胭脂蟲. [Subtitle]: 會用胭脂蟲畫出濃艷的紅色. (4) [Subtitle]: 接著是菸草家族的綠色. [Slogan]: 菸草的家族. (5) [Subtitle]: 以及後面會用到的萬壽菊的金黃色. [Slogan]: 萬壽菊. (6) [Subtitle]: 你知道這些畫家為什麼要用這些天然的植物與礦物來作畫嗎？. (7) [Subtitle]: 因為這些其實就是古代墨西哥金字塔與壁畫上色時所用的材料. (8) [Subtitle]: 接下來他把仙人掌切開. [Slogan]: 仙人掌. (9) [Subtitle]: 準備用它來作畫. (10) [Subtitle]: 先在完成一半的畫上塗上仙人掌的原汁. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為透明的汁液可以讓顏色更牢固. [Variety]: (神奇的部分來囉). (12) [Subtitle]: 最後他用仙人掌沾上某種白色粉末. (13) [Subtitle]: 再次作畫時竟然瞬間從透明變成鮮豔的藍色. [Variety]: 哇. (14) [Subtitle]: 因為那個粉末其實是藍銅礦打磨而成的. [Slogan]: 藍銅礦. (15) [Subtitle]: 而以上所有畫家使用的顏料. [Variety]: (最後的點綴). (16) [Subtitle]: 都曾經為金字塔和神祇增添許多神聖的色彩. (17) [Logo]: 復原的金字塔 (有顏色) VS 風化後變黑白灰的金字塔. [Subtitle]: 只不過經過長時間的風化，金字塔現在少了許多以前的顏色. (18) [Subtitle]: 感謝畫家們到如今也持續使用著. [Variety]: (有機的仙人掌畫作). (19) [Subtitle]: 這個傳統的方式作畫. (20) [Subtitle]: 讓我們有機會看到他們重現墨西哥原住民的記憶與文化. (21) [Logo]: @crown_du.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female narrator speaking in a clear, high-energy Traditional Chinese voice. An acoustic guitar track with a steady, moderate tempo provides a warm and inviting background. Subtle environmental sounds of an outdoor historical site, including distant crowd murmurs and wind, are audible in the mix. (2) As the narrator describes the artist's process, the sounds of paper rustling and light physical movements become more prominent. The vocal delivery is informative and engaging, maintaining a consistent pitch. The background music remains at a lower volume to ensure the narration is the primary focus. (3) A distinct metallic slicing sound is heard as the artist cuts into the cactus, followed by a soft squelching sound of the juice being applied. These incidental noises are crisp and well-captured. A sharp whoosh sound effect marks a transition between different stages of the painting process. (4) The narrator’s voice rises in excitement as she mentions the "magic" part. A bright "ding" sound effect coincides with the visual color change of the pigment. The audio concludes with a more reflective and appreciative tone in the narration as the music fades out, emphasizing the cultural value of the traditional art.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about traditional Mexican indigenous art by demonstrating the use of natural pigments—such as cochineal, tobacco, and marigolds—combined with cactus juice to create vibrant paintings. It highlights the cultural continuity from ancient pyramids to modern-day artists.
